name: OMC
tagline: A closed-loop system that measures and proves the financial value of work shared by people, AI models and agents.

demo.title: Qualify a model migration
demo.summary: Watch a confidence bound tighten as paired cases arrive, and end with a signed evidence statement.

audience.concern: Switch a model or vendor with evidence that outcomes did not get worse.
See what AI work costs and delivers, in numbers finance can recompute.
Show who or what acted, with what authority, and what human access took place.
Verify statements with the public verifier, schema and test vectors.

highlights.title: Four entry audits
highlights.text: Migration qualification, outcome billing audit and vendor bake-off, action authority audit, and human access and disclosure compliance audit.

highlights.title: Numbers finance can re-run
highlights.text: Statements can be re-derived from signed inputs with a pinned estimator, so a result does not rest on trust.

highlights.title: Bounded risk
highlights.text: A kill switch returns traffic to the baseline, so a trial never leaves you without a safe fallback.

highlights.title: Your data stays in your tenant
highlights.text: The measurement runs in the customer’s tenant; a hosted control plane coordinates it.

verifyIt: Select a published statement, recompute it from its signed inputs, and compare the result with the published figure.
